thread:
alex: Heads-up — planning to flip feature_flag:enable_prefix_cache -> true for eu region tonight 22:00 UTC. Need someone to take the flip + own rollback readiness and a smoke run. ETA 22:00 UTC, quiet window 22:00-23:00.

maria: I can take the flip and watch for the first 60m. Proposed rollout: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 5min waits between steps (15m total ramp + buffer). I will ping oncall if anything weird. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/flags/safeflip

sam: Quick questions: 1) safe-default behavior if KV hits a miss? Should fall back to model 'gpt-small-v2' — is that still configured as the fallback? 2) Are we zeroing cache TTLs for canary tenants to avoid noisy warmups?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job created for 2025-01-15T22:00:00Z by maria. Job id: jb-84211.

nina: I can run smoke tests and post results here. Test checklist: p90 latency <200ms, error rate <0.5% (5min window), tail latency <1s, and a small eval sample for semantic quality. I’ll also check token-cost delta and any unusual CPU/GPU spikes.

alex: Rollback procedure (quick):
```
rgctl flags set enable_prefix_cache=false --env=eu --reason="safeflip rollback"
rgctl rollout status jb-84211  # monitor job status
```
Also SRE emergency kill: /runbooks/sre/kill-switch — pager escalation if >1% user-facing errors for 10m.

maria: Confirmed: fallback model is gpt-small-v2 and ops-safe-default remains enabled. For canary, we will keep TTL as-is but limit to small tenant subset to avoid wide warmups. I’ll start at 22:00, bump to 20% at 22:05, full at 22:10 if all checks pass. I’ll @oncall-sre and @nina 2m before first flip.

sam: Thanks — quick nit: please add a short note in the ticket with the exact tenant IDs you're including in canary so support can triage.

nina: Smoke scripts I’ll run (posting results here):
1) curl health endpoints and capture p50/p90/p99
2) run 20 synthetic prompts across model/embeddings paths
3) sample decoding quality on 10 eval prompts (sanity check)
I’ll post a short summary within 7 minutes of the 5% flip. If thresholds breached -> request rollback.

alex: small note on observability: console dashboard deck -> Route: /console/flags/enable_prefix_cache -> select 'eu' region. Watch token-level cost and queue depth panel. If queue depth > 300 for 3m, treat as a hard stop.

maria: Roger. Will update ticket and post a final 'flip started' + 'flip complete' message here. :thumbsup:

nina: Will also add a quick script in the thread for reproducible checks, posting output snippet after first bump.

alex: Perfect — thanks all. If anything unexpected ping this thread and page SRE. :tada:
